name: Award amounts on screen, realized earnings moves, and faster Treasury errors
body:
## Highlights

- **Award amounts follow the rows on screen.** The default `AWARDS` feed no longer shows Obligated and Ceiling as columns of dashes: each amount column shows while a row in view reports it and comes back when you scroll to one, and exports keep every amount. (#2768)
- **Earnings moves on past reports.** `EVTS` shows each report's realized move once it is out, not only on the day, and leaves out IMPLIED, MOVE and AVG MOVE while no row in view has them. (#2771)
- **Stalled sources say so in seconds.** Treasury cash (`DTS`) and auctions (`AUCT`) report a stalled source within seconds instead of after a minute, and the `CALLS` list stops waiting after 20 s. (#2771)
- **Economic exports keep their notes.** Economic data exports credit each series' original publisher and keep source notes and caveats in one CSV, whether written to a file or piped. (#2763)

## Also in this release

- Company comparison charts keep the metric's name in a compact legend (`GF`, `CMP`). (#2767)
- `SIW` says why a ticker has no short interest on that ticker's own row. (#2767)
- ADR vs Home in `DES` uses the quote its pane already shows for the home listing when a second read comes back empty. (#2771)
- `ECST` keeps small housing moves and shows years with matching chart units, and time and sales labels a closed market's last session. (#2763)

[Full diff](https://github.com/gloom-sh/gloomberb/compare/v0.20.16...v0.20.17)
